findings.title: Pagination totalPages off-by-one shows empty last page
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 line 13 totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 users with limit 50) this returns 2 instead of 1, and 100/50 returns 3 instead of 2. Consequence: showingLast is wrong, the next action in the same file allows offset to become equal to user_count via Math.min(offset+limit, user_count), and the admin is able to navigate to a final empty page.

findings.title: Unvalidated limit/offset allows 500 error and unbounded load
findings.body: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 GroupsController#members does limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i and offset = params[:offset].to_i with no clamping, then passes them to limit().offset(). A negative offset produces SQL OFFSET -N which raises in Postgres and returns 500, and a huge or missing-capped limit (e.g. limit=1000000) loads an unbounded number of users via serialize_data, causing memory/CPU DoS. The endpoint should clamp offset to >=0 and limit to a sane max.

findings.title: Admin members routes mismatch frontend URL and controller params
findings.body: In config/routes.rb lines 49-50 delete/put "members" are defined bare inside resources :groups with no on: :member / member block, so the route does not provide a :group_id segment. The frontend in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js calls PUT/DELETE /admin/groups/<id>/members.json with the id in the path, while app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members/remove_member do params.require(:group_id). Real requests therefore either fail routing with 404 or fail with ActionController::ParameterMissing 400 for missing group_id, so add/remove member is completely broken.

findings.title: add_members fails on usernames with spaces
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb line 71 add_members does usernames.split(",").each without stripping whitespace and then User.find_by_username(username). A normal input like "alice, bob" yields " bob" with a leading space which will not match, so the valid user is silently skipped and the admin gets success_json while nothing was added. The loop should strip each token.

findings.title: remove_member bypasses Group#remove domain logic
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb line 90 remove_member does group.users.delete(user_id) instead of the Group#add/Group#remove domain methods used by the old update_patch code and still used by add_members via group.add(user). Association delete skips ActiveRecord callbacks, validations and any bookkeeping inside Group#remove, then group.save is called on an already-mutated join. Consequence is risk of stale user_count/counters, missed side-effects, and divergent add vs remove code paths leaving inconsistent membership state.

findings.title: Specs bypass routing, use wrong verb, miss pagination
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb line 115 the automatic-group remove_member test uses xhr :put while config/routes.rb defines remove_member as DELETE, and all controller specs invoke actions directly with group_id so they never exercise routing. As a result the route/param mismatch that breaks /admin/groups/:id/members.json is not caught, and there is no coverage for GroupsController#members pagination, limit/offset validation, or whitespace handling in add_members.
